description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController which provides basic endpoints for health check, documentation redirect, welcome message, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller handling basic GET endpoints for health status, documentation, welcome message, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message confirming the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original request scheme/host/port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a string 'OK' indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides basic application information about the Spring Boot app.
